lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Li3V4O8 (reduced formula Li3V4O8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both V and Li centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, with V–O distances of 1.89–2.25 Å and Li–O distances of 2.09–2.14 Å. The O centers show two geometric neighbors, one Li and one V. Corner-sharing is observed between V and Li octahedra and between V octahedra, while V octahedra also exhibit edge-sharing.
